Name: TE-VC 2230 SA
Natural: Article descriptionThe Einhell TE-VC 2230 SA wet and dry vac provides deep-down and thorough cleaning, unlike using just a standard vacuum cleaner and mop. This makes a wet & dry vac an ideal addition to standard household cleaning appliances when it comes to stubborn and ingrained dirt. For the ambitious DIY enthusiast, too, a wet and dry vac is a practical helper for cleaning tasks on site, in the workshed or in the hobby room. A wet and dry vac can also be used for cleaning the insides of all kinds of vehicles, right to the tips of the textile material, be it seats and roof linings or mats and interior trim. The Einhell wet and dry vac is an ECO vacuum cleaner, designed for high suction power with low power consumption and delivers 1,150 W. The rust-proof stainless steel tank holds 30 liters and therefore has enough capacity for prolonged jobs. The air regulator is easy to reach on the handle. There is an integrated additional blow connection for blow-cleaning hard-to-reach areas. For easy transportation and mobility there are large wheels and castors. An automatic coupler socket is integrated on the housing for connecting power tools. Also included is a practical accessory holder for tidy stowage of the supplied accessories. The 500 centimeter cable can be wound up on the trolley handle. To enable the wet and dry vac to be cleaned easily, there is a water drain screw for draining the water which has been suctioned up. This product comes with a stainless steel telescopic tube (Ø 36 mm), an extra-long plastic suction hose (Ø 36 mm) with a length of 3 meters, an universal nozzle for carpets and smooth flooring, crevice & upholstery nozzle plus a foam filter, pleated filter and paper dirt bag.See more informationShow less information
